description: Lock the qmd-backed ideate memory search feature shipped in v0.2.35. A SessionEnd hook captures problem + output from each kbg:ideate run into ~/.claude/state/ideate-memory/, a qmd collection indexes them, and the /ideate-search command queries them. This fixture fails if the command, hook, script, skill documentation, or hooks.json registration are missing or broken.

evals.task: Verify scripts/ideate-memory.py is present, executable, and its subcommands are recognised. This is the deterministic half of the feature; if the script cannot parse its own CLI the rest of the surface is unusable.
Verify commands/ideate-search.md exists with the correct frontmatter and instructs the model to run scripts/ideate-memory.py search.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references name: ideate-search
At least one of the checked files references disable-model-invocation: true
At least one of the checked files references scripts/ideate-memory.py search
At least one of the checked files references ideate-search

evals.task: Verify hooks/session/ideate-memory-capture.sh exists, is executable, and is registered in hooks/hooks.json under SessionEnd.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references ideate-memory-capture.sh
At least one of the checked files references SessionEnd

evals.task: Verify skills/ideate/SKILL.md documents the memory search feature and references /ideate-search.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references Ideate memory search
At least one of the checked files references ideate-search
At least one of the checked files references ideate-memory-capture.sh
